from solution import max_Prime_Factors


def test_issue_example_15():
    """Example: max_Prime_Factors(15) == 5."""
    assert max_Prime_Factors(15) == 5  # 15 = 3*5, max is 5

    """Largest prime factor of 12 is 3."""

    """Largest prime factor of 27 is 3."""
    assert max_Prime_Factors(27) == 3  # 27 = 3*3*3, max is 3

    """Largest prime factor of a prime is itself."""
    assert max_Prime_Factors(13) == 13  # 13 is prime, max is 13

def test_issue_larger_composite_13195():
    """Largest prime factor of 13195 is 29."""
    assert max_Prime_Factors(13195) == 29  # 13195 = 5*7*13*29, max is 29


def test_contract_returns_int():
    """Function must return the largest prime factor as an integer."""
    result = max_Prime_Factors(15)
    assert isinstance(result, int)


def test_contract_repeatable_result():
    """Function must give the same result on repeated calls."""
    first = max_Prime_Factors(30)  # 30 = 2*3*5, max is 5
    second = max_Prime_Factors(30)  # 30 = 2*3*5, max is 5
    assert first == 5  # 30 = 2*3*5, max is 5
    assert second == 5  # 30 = 2*3*5, max is 5
